newsitem.title: FRANCE: French deficit above 3.5 pct of GDP - radio.
newsitem.headline: French deficit above 3.5 pct of GDP - radio.

text.p: France's public deficit is probably slightly higher than 3.5 percent of gross domestic product, French radio quoted Christian Sautter, junior minister responsible for budgetary affairs, as saying on Tuesday.
French radio quoted Sautter as saying the deficit "would probably be a little bit higher than 3.5 percent."
President Jacques Chirac said on Monday the deficit/GDP ratio was 3.5.

Earlier on Tuesday, Prime Minister Lionel Jospin held talks with Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn, Sautter and Labour Minister Martine Aubry. All three declined comment on Chirac's statement when they left the meeting.
Strauss-Kahn repeated he was awaiting the results of an audit of public finances being carried out by two members of the Court of Auditors.
The new Socialist-led government is due to announce the results of the audit on Monday.
